title: The Choosing to Go First Kindly
youtube_title: The Choosing to Go First Kindly | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Being new at something is not the same as failing.
summary: At a library story circle, Yael feels shy about a going first so a nervous friend could see how. Instead of pretending not to care, Yael tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Auntie June stays kind and does not push for a show.
